bug_semantics: tcprewrite --fixlen pad calls untrunc_packet, which reallocs the packet buffer when pkthdr->len > pkthdr->caplen. tcpedit_packet still holds ip_hdr (and a local packet pointer) into the pre-realloc allocation; later fix_ipv4_checksums and other editors read that stale pointer (CWE-416 heap UAF). CVE.org state PUBLISHED, not withdrawn/rejected.
flaw_origin: 69831b8186513309f4dd43ca5bacfc34b554ad14 (2014-07-22, Fred Klassen) first wrote packet = safe_realloc(packet, pkthdr->len) in untrunc_packet and switched the argument to u_char **pktdata so the pad path could move the buffer. Parent 16abc7fe749bd3c130204d0b2707caf7cab5894e still memset-padded the existing buffer with no realloc. Later 64132c54 only added PACKET_HEADROOM; b58b23a5 added *pktdata = packet writeback but left caller ip_hdr stale. Direct fix 73008f261f1cdf7a1087dc8759115242696d35da removes the realloc.
